messages:
From: Priya Shah <onboarding@greenridgecorp.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 08:12:00 -0400
Subject: Trouble accepting supplier invite (Coupa)

Hi Marissa,

We tried to accept the supplier portal invite that arrived this morning but the link lands us on an SSO page for a different tenant. The email we received references "greenridgecorp" but when we click the button the SSO redirect shows "greenridge-ops" in the URL and then fails with a "tenant claim mismatch" error.

Screenshot attached — we also tried in incognito and across two browsers. Is there an alternate invite you can send? We need the portal access to submit W-9 and bank account info ahead of the PO.

Attachments: invite_link.html (HTML stub of the invite page), sso-redirect-screenshot.png (image/png)

Thanks,

Thanks for the heads up, Priya — sorry for the friction. Copying Jonas (sales) and Karthik (procurement ops) to coordinate.

Quick facts: this invite came from our Coupa tenant provisioning flow this AM; external vendor claims the SSO redirect points to the wrong tenant slug. Karthik — can you validate the tenant claim in the invite payload and reissue if needed? Jonas — FYI for the account.

Next steps I propose:
- Karthik: check the invite metadata and, if malformed, reissue a fresh invite scoped to greenridgecorp (non-ops).
- Jonas: hold on escalation to the SDR owner until we confirm reissue.
- Priya: appreciate the screenshot — can you also paste the full redirect URL if possible?

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Priya Shah <onboarding@greenridgecorp.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 10:06:00 -0400
Subject: RE: Trouble accepting supplier invite (Coupa)

Hi all — thanks for flagging. I pulled the invite payload from Coupa logs: the tenant_claim field in the invite token was set to "greenridgecorp" (expected) but the routing layer appears to have normalized the slug incorrectly for some invites created between 07:30–08:15 UTC (we have a regex bug that strips hyphens and maps certain suffixes to "-ops").

Workaround for now:
1) Priya — I can manually create a one-time activation link from the procurement console and send it to you; that link will bypass the buggy routing and land you directly on the greenridgecorp tenant.
2) Neha — please confirm we can reissue a corrected batch for any invites in the 07:30–08:15 UTC window.

I'll include the one-time link in a follow-up (short TTL). If Priya still sees the tenant claim in the redirect URL, please paste it verbatim.

-Karthik
Sr. Procurement Ops
Redwood Inference

From: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
To: Priya Shah <onboarding@greenridgecorp.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 14:06:00 -0400
Subject: RE: Trouble accepting supplier invite (Coupa)

Hi Priya — sorry for the bad experience. I checked the routing service logs and confirmed a normalization rule incorrectly rewrites tenant slugs that end in "corp" when a legacy mapping table is hit; that produced the "greenridge-ops" slug you saw. We've deployed a hotfix to the routing layer to stop applying the legacy suffix mapping.

Immediate actions taken:
- Reissued a one-time activation link (TTL 24h) and sent it to you as reissued_invite_link.txt — this bypasses the routing cache and should land on the correct tenant.
- Queued a backfill to regenerate invites created in the 07:30–08:15 UTC window; affected vendors will receive corrected links by EOD.
- Added a monitoring alert for future tenant-claim normalization errors.

Please try the new link now and confirm success. If anything still fails I will join a quick screen-share.

Neha Kapoor
Identity & Security Engineer
Redwood Inference
neha@redwood.com
[Attachment: reissued_invite_link.txt (text/plain)]
